summary: _ansible_selinux_special_fs (list of strings, 2.1+) lists filesystems needing special SELinux contexts, used by AnsibleModule file methods and available as _selinux_special_fs, replacing the old comma-separated SELINUX_SPECIAL_FS.
questions: Which filesystems get special SELinux context handling in modules?
How do I change the list of SELinux special filesystems?

answer_card.title: _ansible_selinux_special_fs
answer_card.answer_md: List of filesystem names that need a special SELinux context, used by `AnsibleModule` file methods. Access via `module._selinux_special_fs` (a list; formerly a comma string `SELINUX_SPECIAL_FS`). Configure with `DEFAULT_SELINUX_SPECIAL_FS`. Added in 2.1.
